name: 12d_dual_arm_traj_oncl_subsample_sparse
description: ONCL robustness sweep for 12d_dual_arm_traj with sparse trajectory demonstrations. For each training trajectory, keep evenly spaced points along the full trajectory so global coverage remains but local sampling density drops.

subsample.formula: For each trajectory of length T, keep round(ratio * T) points sampled evenly from index 0 to T - 1.
subsample.zero_ratio_policy: ratio 0.0 is clamped to at least one point per trajectory

eval_policy: Evaluation remains clean; subsampling is applied only to training demonstrations.
run_parallel_template: conda run -n segment python -m runners.run_parallel --methods oncl --datasets 12d_dual_arm_traj --seeds 0,1,2,3,4,5,6 --sweep train_subsample_ratio=1.0,0.5,0.25,0.1 --override train_subsample_enable=true --override train_subsample_mode=trajectory_even --override train_subsample_keep_n_train=false --outdir outputs/bench/12d_dual_arm_traj_oncl_subsample_sparse_7seed --workers 4 --resume
